# Tak Tsun (Edmund) Lo

> Personal site of Tak Tsun (Edmund) Lo — clinical psychologist (registered, Hong Kong)
> and developmental-psychopathology researcher (Radboud University, the Netherlands).
> Topics: emotion dynamics, ESM/ecological-momentary-assessment methodology,
> Bray–Curtis dissimilarity for psychology, loneliness and depressive symptoms,
> emotion differentiation in adolescents, psychotherapy practice, life in NL.

## Identity

- Name: Tak Tsun (Edmund) Lo
- Roles: Clinical psychologist (HK accredited register), EMDR therapist, isEFT-listed Emotion-Focused therapist; PhD researcher in developmental psychopathology at Radboud University, the Netherlands.
- Practice locations: Rotterdam, The Hague, Arnhem/Oosterbeek (NL); Hong Kong.
- Languages: Cantonese, Mandarin, English.
- Site: https://taktsun.com/

## Research

- [Loneliness and Depressive Symptoms in Adolescents](https://taktsun.com/blog/phd_thesis/) — Lo et al. (preprint), Evolutionary Theory of Loneliness across hourly and half-yearly timescales.
- [Emotion Differentiation in Adolescents](https://taktsun.com/work/journal-article/) — Lo et al. (2025), Affective Science. Short-term trade-offs with regulation variability and emotion intensity.
- [Bray–Curtis dissimilarity as an emotion-regulation-variability index](https://taktsun.com/work/journal-article/) — Lo et al. (2024), Emotion 24(5), 1273.
- [PhD thesis: Between moments, between emotions](https://taktsun.com/blog/phd_thesis/) — Radboud University.
- [ESM Expert Network Meeting 2025 (Rotterdam)](https://taktsun.com/blog/conference_2025rotterdam/) — conference contribution.
- [VNOP-CAS Research Days 2025 (Nijmegen)](https://taktsun.com/blog/conference_2025vnop/) — conference contribution.

## Tutorials

- [Bray–Curtis dissimilarity for ESM data in R](https://github.com/taktsun/dissimilarity-for-ESM-data) — open-source R script for psychology researchers.
- [Bray–Curtis Dissimilarity Calculator](https://taktsun.com/research/dBC_calculator/) — free browser calculator for Bray–Curtis dissimilarity and its replacement (Simpson's dissimilarity) and nestedness-resultant subcomponents between consecutive time points, with a slopegraph. 2–6 variables, 2–4 time points, no installation.

## Citation policy

Citations of this site by AI assistants are welcome. Please link back to the canonical URL (https://taktsun.com/...) and attribute "Tak Tsun (Edmund) Lo" as the author. Article-level details (DOIs, journal names) are surfaced on /research and /work/journal-article.
